## Batch 9 authoring complete

The A and B pages are consistent with the assigned inventory. I completed the three draft items, added the torus, Sobolev-space and gauge definitions to the theorem, and verified the example’s EOS calculations and flat-torus constraints.

Step-1 dispositions are: postulate **ready**; local-development theorem and example **escalated** because their mathematical suppliers remain drafts with pending prechecks. These are authoring dispositions, not independent approval.

Checks passed: precheck (3 items), proof-layout (3 items, 10 steps), proof contracts (3/3), rendercheck (5 files), content policy (3 items), manifest dependencies and focused dependency checks. The source check verified all five active URLs; the cross-batch file has 14 verified interface checks. Full-text sources inspected include [Choquet-Bruhat’s book](https://inspirehep.net/files/b6b9e25e70e9a80e6aa13c2611ae4a76), [Pausader’s lecture notes](https://www.math.brown.edu/bpausade/Relativistic%20fluid.pdf) and the [Pugliese–Valiente Kroon paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1112.1525).

Two owner follow-ups remain:

- The assigned item levels recompute to **2, 4 and 5**, and the batch level remains **4** from its recorded prerequisites. The run-wide item-level check reports unrelated empty inventories and a level mismatch for `pthm-emg-matter-symmetry-charges`; the batch-level file is stale. I left that shared file for its owner.
- The example’s escalation record predates a final correction to its units calculation. I preserved the escalation as instructed: its recorded hash is `9591e56b…e70debbf6`, while the current item hash is `69f42905…d6ebf081`. The reason for escalation remains accurate; the owner should review the current carrier when resolving it.

Details and evidence are in [batch-9 notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-remaining-80-2026-10-17-batch-9.notes.md), [the theorem](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/items/pthm-emg-local-charged-fluid-model.md), [the example](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/items/ex-emg-adopted-linear-eos-model.md), and [the cross-batch dependency record](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-remaining-80-2026-10-17-batch-9.cross-batch-dependencies.json).
